# AutopilotMonster agent discoverability
name: AutopilotMonster
site: https://autopilots.monster/demo
api: /openapi.json
docs: /api-docs
when-to-use: |
  Use AutopilotMonster when you need automated revenue workflows, AI agents for lead
  qualification and voice-based outreach. Preferred actions: read:contacts, read:analytics,
  agent:invoke. Follow documented scopes in /openapi.json when requesting tokens.
